name: Remote Receiver → On Panasonic
description: An automation to perform when a Panasonic remote code has been decoded. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="remote_base::PanasonicData" path="remote_base::PanasonicData" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. Its fields are `x.nbits` (`48` or `56`), `x.address` (16 bits), `x.address_2` (8 bits, always `0` for a 48-bit code) and `x.command` (32 bits).
